section_1.title: The 'Why': Explicit vs. Implicit Curves
section_1.content: Visual introduction: Compare y = f(x) (Explicit - a simple line) with x² + y² = r² (Implicit - a circle). Explain that some curves cannot be solved easily for 'y', necessitating a new approach.
section_1.example: Visualizing a 'Slinky' spring vs. a simple string: sometimes you can't isolate one strand (y) without tangling everything.

section_2.title: The Core Concept: The Chain Rule
section_2.content: Recall the prerequisite: The Chain Rule (d/dx[f(g(x))] = f'(g(x)) * g'(x)). Emphasize that when we differentiate y with respect to x, we must treat y as an inner function 'y(x)', resulting in dy/dx.
section_2.example: If y = u³, then d/dx(y) = 3u² * (du/dx). Applying this to 'y' itself: d/dx(y²) = 2y * (dy/dx).

section_3.title: The 3-Step Procedure
section_3.content: Present the algorithm: (1) Differentiate both sides of the equation with respect to x. (2) Collect all terms containing dy/dx on one side. (3) Factor out dy/dx and solve.
section_3.example: Applying to x³ + y³ = 6xy (The Folium of Descartes). Show the animation of terms moving across the equal sign like shifting pieces on a game board.

section_4.title: Visual Application: Tangent Lines
section_4.content: Show a graph of the Folium of Descartes. Pick a specific point (e.g., 3,3). Use the derived dy/dx to calculate the slope and draw the tangent line dynamically.
section_4.example: A robotic arm tracking a point on the 'Folium' curve—the arm's orientation (slope) is determined by the dy/dx we just calculated.

section_5.title: Summary & Quick Check
section_5.content: Reinforce the 'golden rule': Whenever you differentiate a y-term, 'tag' it with a dy/dx. Final recap of the workflow.
section_5.example: A 'Quick Quiz' animation: Differentiate 5y² + x = 10. The correct 'tag' 10y(dy/dx) + 1 = 0 appears as a badge of success.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text("- " + line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)

            # Parametric form of Folium of Descartes
